_readme: THE COMPANY PROPERTY, mccluster.org: McCluster Corp's house.
tools/build-company-site.mjs renders this file plus data/seo/entity-graph.json into
workers/mccluster/src/company-site/pages.generated.js, which the Worker serves on the
mccluster.org host. Every claim here is already verified elsewhere in the repository
(entity graph, credential PDFs, the platform and services pages). Do not add a claim
here that the evidence ledger or a primary document does not support.
Doors link to where each product lives today. Products keep their working URLs;
this page describes and connects them (data/seo/domain-architecture.json).

meta.title: McCluster Corp · Technology, Education, Civic, Media & Creative Products and Services
meta.description: McCluster Corp is the operating organization behind the McCluster Platform, Equity Uprise, the Uprise Action Network, PRIM3, McCluster Sites, and the studio's media, creative and music work. Founded in 2025 by Matthew McCluster; based in Bridgeport, Connecticut.
meta.og_description: The operating organization behind a growing ecosystem of technology, education, civic, media and creative products and services: the McCluster Platform, Equity Uprise, the Uprise Action Network, PRIM3 and McCluster Sites.

hero.headline: The company behind the McCluster ecosystem.
hero.lede: McCluster Corp is an operating organization that builds and runs technology, education, civic, media and creative products and services. It was founded in 2025 by Matthew McCluster, is based in Bridgeport, Connecticut, and works across Connecticut and Georgia.

doors_intro: Each one is its own door. Open it and you are in the product itself.

product_map.line: The product map: how the public record, the platform and Control, Equity Uprise, the Action Network, PRIM3 and the studio connect, and the member loop from a campaign to verified action.

doors.name: McCluster Platform
doors.line: The platform the company runs on: PostgreSQL with row-level security, an API on Cloudflare Workers, McCluster Core on a Linux server, payments, and releases that verify the live commit and roll back on failure.

doors.name: Equity Uprise
doors.line: McCluster Corp's public-interest project, combining policy research, civic education, community action, culture and media. Its front page is the Docket 516R public record.

doors.name: Uprise Action Network
doors.line: An action-first campaign network connected to Equity Uprise's action model: a campaign leads to a mission, the mission asks for proof, and a reviewer verifies the action.

doors.name: PRIM3
doors.line: A free technology and cybersecurity learning project built on the PRIM Method: Principles, Rhythm, Immersion and Missions.

doors.name: McCluster Sites
doors.line: Websites built and kept online on the client's own domain, with hosting, SSL and backups, plus website and social media management.

doors.name: Media and creative production
doors.line: Photography, video, brand films, campaign concepts and creative direction, shot and produced in house.

doors.name: Music and catalogue
doors.line: A registered catalogue under McCluster Corp's ISRC registrant code QT6KV, sync licensing, and hosting and licensing terms for independent creators.

work.title: Clients
work.body: Websites, management, photography, film and music are scoped on a free call and priced on one page.

work.title: Participants
work.body: Campaigns run on the Uprise Action Network: join a campaign, take a mission, submit proof, and a reviewer verifies the action.

work.title: Partners and institutions
work.body: Write to the company about a partnership, a program, or a pilot of a product.

work.title: Researchers and media
work.body: The public record, with the primary document behind each entry, and a press kit.

operations.heading: Technology and operations
operations.body: One platform carries every product: durable data and identity in Supabase, a single public edge on Cloudflare (the mccluster Worker at api.mccluster.org), persistent execution in McCluster Core, and source, tests and reviewed releases in one GitHub repository. Products are workloads on that platform, not separate stacks.

founder.heading: Founder
founder.body: Matthew McCluster founded McCluster Corp and runs it: he sets the platform's architecture, directs its products, and leads its creative work. His own work, résumé and music live on his property.
